name: Shailaputri
quote: May Shailaputri's steadfastness keep your spirit grounded and strong.

name: Skandamata
quote: May Skandamata's loving care bring peace, courage, and joy.

name: Siddhidatri
quote: May Siddhidatri's grace bring harmony, insight, and fulfillment.

name: Katyayani
quote: May Katyayani's fearless strength guide you to stand for what is right.

name: Kalaratri
quote: May Kalaratri's fierce protection dispel fear and light your way.

name: Brahmacharini
quote: May Brahmacharini's devotion and discipline lead you toward wisdom.
